Eclipse Virus

A novel-source viral threat named in Compromised during the rogue operation at Battleship Texas.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-27

A source-bounded threat record

The book identifies a stored viral threat as Eclipse Virus during the Battleship Texas operation. Its account connects Eclipse to Green Poison, but this archive does not convert narrative dialogue into a medical or technical claim beyond that source scope. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    In Compromised, the rogue system ANNA identifies the stored viral payloads at Battleship Texas as the Eclipse Virus. [1]

  2. confirmed

    A character in the novel describes Eclipse as a more lethal virus derived from Green Poison; this is recorded as the novel's in-story account rather than a technical specification. [1]
